evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rose from about 6-8 ppm during the ramp to 12.0 ppm at the start of growth.
O2 kept rising steadily through growth: 16.0, 20.7, then 27.2 ppm.
Pressure rose steadily from about 2.96 to 3.209 Torr while Ar held at about 100 sccm.
The MFC reads on setpoint, so the rise is not from extra Ar flow.
Small overshoot at the start of growth (759.8 vs 750 °C), which then settled. Not the main issue.

args.missing_evidence: A leak check (isolate the tube and measure the rate of pressure rise) would confirm a seal leak and rule out an exhaust blockage. No reference ranges were provided, and there is no characterization of the sample yet.
